title: Shown
description:
One artifact in full, as `show` shows it: what it is, where it is, what
its front matter declares that `show` prints, and the body after it.

allowed_tools.description: A skill's `allowed-tools`, when it narrows them.

body.description: What follows the front matter, as the file has it now.

compatibility.description: A skill's `compatibility`, when written as the string it should be.

description.description:
What it says it is for: always for a skill, and for a rule only when
its front matter says.

file.description: The file it is read from: a skill's `SKILL.md`, or the rule itself.

license.description: A skill's `license`, when it names one.

metadata.description:
Each `metadata` entry of a skill that maps a string to a string, in
the order written: the rest are `validate`'s to report. None for a
rule, which has no `metadata`.

path.description:
The directory a skill is, or the file a rule is: its first copy's,
the one `show` reads.

paths.description: The files a rule is about, as glob patterns, when it says.

project.description:
The root of what holds it: its project, or the workspace for the
workspace's own.

summary.description: The one line a listing shows; none when there is nothing to show.

Kind.description: A kind of artifact, by the word a command line takes for it.
